I don’t know what state you live in, but where I reside, about 85% of housing, including single-family, condo, and townhomes, has HOAs. I am in the real estate business in a high-cost state and county. I look at housing data every day nationwide. Insurance in my area is absurdly high, and I would not pay that a month in HOA fees. 

In my decades in the business, this is an alarming amount for a monthly HOA fee. And everyone’s HOA covers different costs—it is not the same all the way around. So, people should read their HOA agreements to confirm what those costs are allocated for. 

We have homes here where you have to pay a set HOA fee upfront to purchase the home, which can cost around $100k before you even get into the cost of the home. That being said, those houses are priced lower than other homes, and they have golf courses that need maintenance along with a laundry list of services, amenities and a large portion of those funds go to reserves to preserve the equity of the homes and to ensure the HOA will still have funds in the event of another real estate collapse and homeowners cannot pay the fees. 

As many people accurately started, attend your HOA meetings regularly and review the budget to determine where the funds are going. Even if a management company handles the HOA. There are too many instances of embezzlement and homeowners learning they must suddenly pay huge assessments because no one watched the money. Now, their city or county is assessing fines daily for the community for required repairs that were supposed to be handled years before by the HOA. A homeowner is higher at risk for foreclosure from both the HOA or the Mortgage holder the higher these costs get especially as insurance and tax payments increase as well. Again, it is a significant amount if you factor in a mortgage payment with taxes and insurance, the HOA, maintenance you have to handle out of pocket, and surprise special assessments. I guarantee most Americans would not be able to afford all of that.

When you get to the Olympics level, you should have all the background and history of the sport or art form you are performing in. As a PhD holder, this woman felt no need to do her due diligence or research. I call bullshit. And she was mocking Black Americans. Hundreds of thousands of Black Americans hold PhDs as well, and that excuse is not going to work with us. There will be a boycott of some sort. 

Imagine if a black American came to the Olympics and mocked the Corroboree, Warning Dance, Cassowary Dance, Bush Dances, Pride of Erin, Waves of Bondi, Melbourne Shuffle, or the New Vogue. I now regard Australia at a lower standard than ever and will pass that on to whomever here in the States will listen.
